thread:
sam: Hey runtime folks — can we get a quick bench for the new model `mistral_inference_v1` for onboarding? Need latencies and tokens/sec for seq=512, batch sizes 1/4/8, temperature 0.0. Target infra: dedicated-gpu-a100-80 pool. Also include memory footprint and estimated cost per 1M tokens.

jia: I can run this today. Which harness + dataset do you want? the default chat prompt or long-form generation?

sam: Use the long-form eval harness (tokenized wiki paragraphs). Command we usually use: `./bench/run_bench --model mistral_inference_v1 --seq 512 --batches 1,4,8 --temp 0.0 --runs 100 --profile` — please attach logs and perf summary.

jia: Got it. Will run on gpu-node-17 (a100-80GB) in dedicated pool. ETA ~45m.

perf-bot: Job queued: bench-1753456790. Notifying when complete.

[~50 minutes later]

jia: Results uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/mistral_onboarding/1753456789/. Quick summary below. Raw logs + pprof there.

perf-bot: --SUMMARY--
Model: mistral_inference_v1
Hardware: a100-80GB (dedicated-gpu-a100-80 pool)
Sequence: 512 tokens
Runs: 100 (warmup 10)

Batch=1: p50=82ms, p95=140ms, tokens/sec=210, GPU mem=48GB, cost est= $0.35 per 1k tokens
Batch=4: p50=210ms, p95=360ms, tokens/sec=720, GPU mem=60GB, cost est= $0.12 per 1k tokens
Batch=8: p50=430ms, p95=760ms, tokens/sec=1300, GPU mem=72GB, cost est= $0.07 per 1k tokens

Notes: attention kernel shows increased time at seq=512; KV cache warmup stable. Profile: top time spent in `matmul_attention` and `kv_store`. pprof at s3 path.

maria: Thanks Jia — quick question: how does this compare to our current catalog entry `redwood-open-7b-quant` for same sequence? Do we have regression numbers?

luis: I pulled the baseline: redwood-open-7b-quant (a100) batch=1 p50=60ms, tokens/sec=260. So mistral_v1 is ~35% slower single-stream but better throughput at larger batch sizes. Memory footprint is higher.

andrew: Profiling note — see the attached flamegraph: `matmul_attention` takes ~42% of CPU kernel time. On the runtime side we can try enabling the new fused-attention kernel (flag: `--use-fused-attn=true`) to see if p95 improves. Also check cuBLAS workspace tuning.

sam: Good catch. Jia, can you re-run batch=1 with `--use-fused-attn=true` and `--cuda-cublas-workspace=32M` to see delta? If improvement >15% p95 we can consider defaulting that kernel in the model profile.

jia: Re-run scheduled now. small note: enabling fused-attn requires libcspr 0.9.x, which is on gpu-node-17 already.

perf-bot: Quick re-run results (batch=1, fused-attn on): p50=65ms, p95=110ms, tokens/sec=240. GPU mem same.

maria: That reduces the single-stream gap quite a bit. Cost per 1k tokens now ~ $0.30. Still higher than 7b quant for batch=1, but acceptable for customers who need quality/throughput tradeoff.

andrew: Recommend we add two model variants to the catalog: `mistral_inference_v1` (default, fused-attn enabled) and `mistral_inference_v1-lowmem` (quantized, lower mem but ~10% slower). Add rollout policy: dedicated pool only, canary=5% for 24h then 25% for 48h.

sam: OK — I'm going to create the catalog PR with the numbers and the SLO suggestions. Will tag eng-runtime and devex for docs.

luis: One more ops item — I saw a small bump in GPU SM utilization during batch=8 runs, adding a note to autoscaler: allow +1 node headroom when onboarding new model until steady-state. ops-bot will open a ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-4821 — "Autoscaler headroom for mistral_inference_v1 onboarding".

sam: Great work team :rocket: — if no objections I'll merge the onboarding PR this afternoon and schedule canary rollout tomorrow. Please add any follow-ups in the PR.

maria: LGTM :thumbsup:

andrew: LGTM, suggest smoke test harness for end-to-end response shapes before canary.

sam: Will add smoke tests. Closing thread once PR merged. Thanks everyone!
